gates.detail: Confirm publisher account, registration/payment if needed, verified contact, 2-step verification and dashboard identity requirements. No credentials in this kit.

Plaintext credential and browsing-derived caches need a reviewed persistence/threat-model decision. Trusted-context access is not encryption; an encryption key kept with the data must not be presented as profile-compromise protection.
Verify activeTab necessity against Netflix host permissions; remove or substantiate it with tested user-visible need before submission.
Listing prominently explains data flow; decide and implement a first-run notice/privacy link before automatic requests as the conservative path.
Confirm permissions/licensing for current provider/endpoints and optional Netflix public-title enrichment, or approve a reduced authorized-source design. Public accessibility is not authorization.
Arrange legitimate reviewer Netflix access if required, through private dashboard instructions only.
Accept final candidate on a real signed-in Netflix page, including expanded previews, episode rows, matching, controls and upgrade behavior. Synthetic screenshots are not live acceptance.
Match live dashboard categories to final implementation and publish an affirmative Limited Use statement only after the publisher verifies it is true.
